scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && turbo run dev --filter=api --filter=worker --filter=web
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/worker && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && turbo run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && turbo run test
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w packages/config && npm run build -w packages/types && npm run build -w packages/logger && npm run build -w packages/validation && npm run build -w packages/auth && npm run build -w packages/database
